summaryForNext: Plan and delivery diverged: the A2UI switch was built then removed, the real model broke the 2,500-token cap and the stream filter after every mocked gate passed, and the ledger lagged eight changes. All 10 changes shipped; goals met except the wider UAR integration (partial by D-25). Open: security W2 and W3, the duplicated card and prose, an over-budget bundle, PRs #38 to #40 unmerged. Recommended next phase: site-chat-hardening-and-polish, then the rest of uar-integration.
